notes: Pacts on Sepolia uses Pact (PACT), a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no owner, mint, pause or fee switch. Deploy Guilds before Realm. Guilds(address token, uint256 epochLength) takes $token and 3600. Realm(address token, address guilds, uint256 epochLength, uint256 seasonLength, uint256 troopPrice, uint256 feeBps) takes $token, $contract:Guilds, 3600, 604800, 1000000000000000000 and 500; its constructor reverts unless Guilds was built with the same token and epoch length and unless seasonLength is a multiple of epochLength. Realm creates Diplomacy and Season in its constructor and Season creates Banners, whose sole minter is Season; each child records its creator as an immutable and trusts only that address. Discover the children through Realm.diplomacy(), Realm.season() and Season.banners(); they are not separate factory deployments and take no manifest entry. Epochs are 3600 seconds and seasons 604800 seconds (168 epochs); a troop costs 1000000000000000000 token units (1 PACT) and 500 basis points (5%) of each troop purchase funds the season prize pool. Troop price and fee are deployment choices matching the accepted defaults in script/Deploy.s.sol; the brief fixes only the epoch and season lengths. No contract has an owner argument, so $owner is unused; no initialization call or constructor ETH is required and the game contracts receive no token allocation. Every payout is funded by player payments: troop purchases, fees and pact bonds. The accepted revision added two constructor-independent rules the manifest does not configure: Guilds reads Realm.tile() when an Attack proposal is created and rejects it unless the named holder currently holds the tile, and a Pact proposal carries a minimum counter-bond in data3 that Diplomacy.sign enforces on the partner's bond. Permissionless maintenance calls: Realm.settle(), Realm.settleStep(maxAttacks) and Realm.settlePending(max) settle ended epochs, Season.close(season) fixes standings and prize shares at season end, Season.claim(season, guildId) and Season.mintPeaceBanner(season, guildId) pay prizes and mint banners to members who joined before the season ended, and Diplomacy.expire(pactId) returns bonds of an unbroken pact once its last epoch has passed. Membership is open by design, so a majority of newly joined wallets can direct a guild treasury and last-second joiners share season prizes; the README documents this as an accepted consequence of the approved rules. The pool pairs with native ETH and has no hook; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 for a 1:1 opening price. A pinned policy specifying an opening market cap determines the effective opening price in the deployer. Policy and signed artifact linkage are supplied by services.
